description: Wire-level compression probe (Stage 7e slice 0). Uses raw-socket mode so the on-the-wire `Content-Encoding` is observable (Node's fetch transparently decompresses). Pins the reference's `compression@1.8.1` middleware surface: the default threshold (1024 B), the negotiation preference `br > gzip > deflate`, the `Vary: Accept-Encoding` invariant (always set when the middleware runs, even when compression is skipped), the MIME-based skip for non-compressible types, the HEAD / no-transform / Range skip conditions, and the Stage 7d OPTIONS-as-GET composition. Backs SRV-CLI-012 and closes Q-002. Snapshots here are reference-only until Stage 7e slice 2 lands the irserve implementation.

files.big-ce-br.html:
